source:
@@U04675@@
That weird attack of sex ends in a rash, those blasted flames are now burned out, and so, as well I should, I curse you each and every one!

@@U04677@@
He whom the Light of Creation embraces Finds in salvation All of the graces. Singing great praises, Rise up to your goal; The air now is purified, Breathe now, blest soul!

@@U04678@@
(They rise into the air, bearing 浮士德 ’s immortal part.)

@@U04680@@
(Looking about.)

@@U04681@@
What’s this, what’s this? Where have they moved off to? That gang of juveniles caught me off my guard! And off they fly to heaven with their booty! That's it, yes, now I know, that’s why they kept nibbling away at the grave! I’ve been robbed! A great, a unique treasure, the noble soul that pledged itself to me, has been cunningly filched from under my very nose! Where to lodge an appeal? Where to find an ear to bend? Restore to me what's rightly mine? Ah, you old goat, bested in your old age! And you deserved it, too! A fine pickle you've got yourself in, you have! Mismanaged disgracefully! All that waste of energy!
translation:
@@U04675@@
那种奇怪的性攻击以皮疹告终，那些被诅咒的火焰现在已经被烧毁了，所以，我也应该，我诅咒你们每一个人！

@@U04677@@
拥抱创造之光的人会在救赎中找到所有的恩典。歌颂伟大，奋发向上；现在空气被净化了，现在呼吸吧，祝福的灵魂！

@@U04678@@
（他们升到空中，承载着浮士德的不朽部分。）

@@U04680@@
（环视四周。）

@@U04681@@
这是什么，这是什么？他们搬到哪里去了？那帮少年让我措手不及！然后他们带着战利品飞向天堂！就是这样，是的，现在我知道了，这就是为什么他们一直在啃坟墓！我被抢了！一件伟大的、独一无二的宝藏，向我许诺的高贵灵魂，就在我眼皮子底下被狡猾地偷走了！到哪里提出上诉？哪里可以找到可以弯曲的耳朵？把本来属于我的东西还给我？啊，你这个老山羊，在你的晚年被打败了！而你也是应得的！你已经把自己放进了一个很好的泡菜里，你有！管理不善可耻！所有这些都是浪费能源！
